# Tier `amd-rdna3`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `vulkan` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 16384 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `f16` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 16384 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `gpu` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4-e4b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

This tier's media bindings are **RAM-gated** (`config_seed_ram_mid_high`): the installer applies
them only when the detected `ram_tier` is `mid` or `high`, so the same tier on a low-RAM box
honestly serves text only.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_max_tokens` | `4096` |
| `agent_model` (RAM-gated: applied on `mid`/`high` only) | `gemma-4-26b-agent` |
| `agent_thinking` | `off` |
| `fleet_agent_enabled` (RAM-gated: applied on `mid`/`high` only) | `true` |
| `fleet_max_concurrent_jobs` (RAM-gated: applied on `mid`/`high` only) | `1` |
| `fleet_sampler` | `pdh-shared` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #7 (780M/gfx1103 iGPU + 64GB dual-channel DDR5, Vulkan UMA). SAFE FLOOR: f16 KV + 16K ctx + 26B [SUPERSEDED 2026-09-21 (wiring-debt W4): this read 'cpu-moe'; RAM is overflow only (operator rule 2026-09-10), and this is a unified-memory iGPU, so the 26B now runs on the iGPU - moe_26b 'gpu'. MEASURED 2026-11-10 on <node-j>: 23.5 tok/s, cold load 23 s] (ram_tier mid/high; else dropped). Research 2026-07-23 (J1): the floor is deliberately BELOW what this hardware measures elsewhere - 26B-A4B Q4_K_M runs FULLY OFFLOADED (-ngl 99, weights in GTT/shared memory) at ~20-25 tok/s tg on a 780M with dual-channel DDR5 (two independent community measurements; the earlier 'cpu-moe = very slow' note was wrong for dual-channel boxes), and Vulkan FA + q8_0 KV is production-supported since the Feb-Mar 2026 AMD tuning PRs. selftest.ps1's H3 canaries (fa_q8kv / moe_full_offload / ctx_sweep) MEASURE all three promotions on the real box; the agent applies them canary-gated per SETUP-AGENT.md (amd-rdna3 chapter). REQUIRES a llama.cpp win-vulkan build >= Mar-2026 (the newest complete build the installer takes satisfies this; never install a build below the floor) and flash-attn EXPLICITLY 'on' (never auto: a silent FA-off then fails quantized-V loads on Gemma). Single-channel RAM is a clean ~2x tg loss - confirm dual-channel at install. MEASURED 2026-11-10: the first receipt is at the end of this note. J-media 2026-07-28 (a contributor's amd-rdna3 box - the D9 audit gap): STT via the whisper.cpp Vulkan build. Vision reuses this tier's resident E4B + mmproj, so no extra multi-GB download on a UMA box. Vision keeps the CLIP encoder on CPU (--no-mmproj-offload). The REASON, stated accurately: llama.cpp #20081 reports mmproj quality degradation on Vulkan, but the maintainer could not reproduce it across several devices and the reporter closed it inconclusively - so quality alone is weak evidence. The load-bearing fact is in the same thread: running model + mmproj both on the Vulkan backend of a Radeon 780M iGPU gives a hard vk::DeviceLostError immediately after 'decoding image batch 1/8', reproducibly, on the exact silicon this tier targets. Keeping the encoder on CPU avoids that crash path and costs only encoder throughput; the LLM still decodes on the GPU. Both seats pin GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 (multi-ICD boxes). The whisper.cpp Vulkan build and both whisper weights come from the installer since 0.214.0 (it builds whisper-server on the box). MEASURED 2026-11-10 on <node-j>: the speech sample transcribes in 5.8 s, a VQA answer takes 4.6 s and an OCR read 1.7 s. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: reviewed; seats are the best that fit — no change. AGENT LANE 2026-11-06: 64 GB boxes bind the 26B agent seat from config_seed_ram_mid_high, the same RAM gate that renders it, and opt the node into remote agent work with one worker, because the seat serves --parallel 1. Below that band the lane stays on the workhorse and the node stays out of remote agent work, since E4B has failed fleet-smoke on another APU class. MEASURED 2026-11-10 on <node-j> for the local lane only: gemma-4-26b-agent passes the acceptance gate's known-answer step in 33 s from cold, and on one grounded task (two files to read, a code to quote and two counts to add) it answers correctly in 5 steps and 16.5 s of model time; offload-e4b answers the same task correctly in 3 steps and 5.8 s. That is one task per seat, not an agent contract. Remote agent work is unmeasured (the box is not joined to a fleet). The ComfyUI script keys are blanked and upscale_model removed: this tier has no ComfyUI, and the shipped defaults read as bound routes in doctor. IGPU MEDIA 2026-11-06: the 64 GB band binds video (FastWan), animate (VACE + depth), voice (Chatterbox) and music (ACE-Step), copied from amd-gcn's measured set, with the same RAM gate as the 26B seat because each job needs more memory than a smaller box can give it. The installer fetches every weight the seed names and builds da3-cli and a patched audiocpp_cli on the box (setup/build-engine-vulkan.ps1): depth-anything.cpp has no releases, and audio.cpp's Windows zip cannot carry the planner patch music needs. The timeouts, token caps and sizes are amd-gcn's, measured on a Vega 7 under Linux. MEASURED 2026-11-10 on <node-j> at the acceptance gate's sizes: video 256x256, 17 frames, in 75 s; animate 17 frames in 236 s; voice 3.8 s of speech in 14 s (its transcript matches); music 4.6 s in 73 s. The production sizes are unmeasured on a 780M. UPSCALE AND INPAINT 2026-11-06: both run through sd-cli with no ComfyUI, from the base seed because they need no RAM the image lane does not. Upscale is `sd-cli -M upscale` with 4xNomos2_hq_mosr (CC-BY-4.0, commercial use allowed with attribution; the installer fetches it); a 2x request is met by an ffmpeg lanczos resample of the model's 4x output. Inpaint reuses the image lane's Z-Image Turbo files with --mask and --strength 1.0 and composites the render back over the source, so the pixels outside the mask are exact; removal is clean, while a large repaint with a new object can show the mask's rectangle because Z-Image is not an inpaint model. Both pin --backend vulkan0 and keep the VAE on the GPU (--vae-tiling), and do not take the image lane's --vae-on-cpu. Measured on a Vulkan GPU of another class (upscale 512 to 2048 in 8 s, inpaint clean) and MEASURED 2026-11-10 on <node-j>: upscale 720x240 to 1440x480 in 4.0 s, inpaint 720x240 in 36 s, image 512x512 in 62 s. FIRST RECEIPT 2026-11-10 (<node-j>: Ryzen 9 7940HS, Radeon 780M, 64 GB DDR5, Windows 11, driver 32.0.32015.7029, llama.cpp b12244; docs/tiers/reports/amd-rdna3-node-j.md): selftest verdict pass. offload-e4b 24.1 tok/s (cold load 17.6 s), gemma4-e2b 44.7 tok/s (6.0 s), gemma4-26b-a4b 23.5 tok/s (23.0 s). llama-bench on E4B: pp512 1087.5, tg128 25.2 tok/s. The depth canary generates to 7000 tokens with no device loss. The ctx sweep loads and generates at 8K, 16K and 32K (23.2, 23.6, 24.0 tok/s). fa_q8kv passes with flash attention confirmed on (word overlap 1.0). The swap eviction cycle leaves one server. The GPU VAE decode is clean and quicker (41.3 s against 68.2 s with the VAE on the CPU). Lowest available RAM over the selftest and every acceptance render: 17.5 GB of 55.8 visible; no display-driver reset. The floor (f16 KV, 16K) stays the tier default because one box is not the class; q8_0 KV and 32K are per-box promotions, applied with OFFLOAD_KV_TYPE and OFFLOAD_CTX_SIZE at install, and the cache cap for this RAM tier is 8192 MiB.
